title: First recurring Monitor-to-human-learning slice for Anth.us, Papyrus and TI
description:
LATEST architecture correction (Ryan, 2026-10-20): BOTH modes must work and be tested from the start. First stage is ONE SHARED REMOTE Cyclotron with publication-relevance outputs for academic Papyrus, Threat Intelligence and Anth.us. Evaluate the SAME discovered item/revision together across these outputs to share Jev work; three independent models/calls/cyclotrons do not satisfy this requirement. Second stage is one INTEGRATED Cyclotron in each publication's Papyrus backend, with multiple classifiers, one per section. Integrated remains a supported deployment alternative generally, and is required here for the section layer. Neither mode is claimed working until verified end to end.

Verify the actual central lab/API endpoint separately from the cyclotron.anth.us marketing hostname, existing account and role-based capabilities, shared multi-output engine/binding, and integrated section bindings before any predictions or seeds. Preserve immutable source revision and shared decision identity, then scope prediction/label provenance to account, publication, output, binding revision and prediction fingerprint. Never silently fall back to local/independent first-stage models or seed/train the wrong backend. New persistent access/IAM or infrastructure requires exact approval; do not provision as an inferred quick-win requirement. No production merge/deploy authorization.

LATEST acceptance experiment order: first collect and persist the real Hacker News batch and present titles/URLs/provenance and publication context promptly; then capture Ryan's explicit yes/no and optional reasons; then run/evaluate the real current classifier baseline; only AFTER that baseline may verified already-human-accepted examples with his reasons be exercised through the existing seed mechanism, followed by a comparison. Preserve evaluation items separately from training/seeds where feasible. Capturing human evaluation answers is not permission to feed them into the baseline learner before the baseline. If existing delegated-human/priming behavior cannot maintain that separation, report the exact limitation rather than silently contaminate the comparison or forge tokens/labels. Preserve counts, snapshots/model versions, decision and feedback receipts and exact ordering; tiny samples may support process evidence only, not meaningful accuracy claims. No new UI prerequisite.

LATEST first milestone and implementation scope: real recurring Monitor -> persisted deduplicated References and provenance -> the correct publication's REAL Cyclotron prediction -> human review in the EXISTING curation UI -> an authorized human label under current authority rules -> verified applied steering/training receipt. Predictions, agent judgments and advisory feedback never count as human labels. Recorded, queued and applied feedback are distinct; claim training/optimization only with an applied receipt, never from prediction alone. Respect existing proof/authorization gates; do not bypass them to manufacture a receipt.

One configured Monitor per initial publication is sufficient. Start with 1–2 source adapters: Hacker News first, then a verified current Hugging Face paper/academic source only as a useful bounded increment. Initial consumers are Anth.us, the academic Papyrus publication and Threat Intelligence; exact source-to-publication mapping is flexible and one upstream source may serve multiple independently scoped classifiers. Verify current application/binding ownership and guidance; never assume legacy dbsyytcm9drqa. Pilobolus is not an initial target because its serendipitous content is harder to monitor, not because it is permanently excluded. Preserve recurring, source-appropriate cadence around 15 minutes, checkpoints, dedup/new/updated items, provenance and visible stage failures so relevant discoveries and the learning loop are available for morning review.

Rich Monitoring UI/new inbox, email/unsubscribe, expensive LLM section/desk triage and Markus for everything are MUCH LOWER priority and MUST NOT block this slice. Use existing capabilities and curation UI; choose the operator/configuration interface during implementation, with no required new configuration UI. Additional adapters, 3–5 source expansion and richer views are later increments. Reuse current scheduling/intake/classification/label paths and coordinate intake PR367 instead of duplicating it.

Ryan explicitly authorized implementation of THIS first slice after filing, with public-source intake/classification needed for it. That does not authorize production merge/deployment, new persistent access/IAM, purchases, mailbox/MX changes, subscriptions, AWS-console browser work or unrelated benchmarks. No fabricated human labels. Other new feature plans remain unstarted.

Deliver a bounded Hacker News recurring discovery slice using existing scheduler/worker, intake, canonical Reference and Cyclotron contracts. Inspect active work/PR367 first. One Monitor per initial publication and 1–2 adapters suffice; select the smallest useful interface without building a configuration UI. Implement meaningful observable tests for persisted resumable intake, canonical dedup/revisions/provenance, correctly scoped real prediction metadata, existing human-review handoff, current authorized label transport and truthful applied-feedback receipts. New rich UI/email/triage/Markus work is not an acceptance prerequisite. Real source processing/classification is authorized; actual human review must remain human and a missing applied receipt is an explicit remaining acceptance gap rather than invented training.

Explicit delivery sequence: checkpoint 1 gets the real Hacker News Monitor fetching/saving persisted deduplicated References with provenance and an executable scheduling path; report concrete evidence immediately. Checkpoint 2 immediately runs the correct publication-scoped real Cyclotron predictions on that collected batch and reports decision evidence. Checkpoint 3 follows through the existing human review/authorized-label/applied-feedback receipt path. Do not hold earlier checkpoints for the complete loop, and do not build a new UI first.

Checkpoint 3 is specified in PPY-437a10e4-9647-4aa8-8f45-b7db98868cf5: conversational publication-specific yes/no and optional why, faithful existing delegated-human labeling with valid authority/token and message/actor provenance, received/applied receipt checks, inspection of truly human-accepted seed References without duplicate backfill, and meaningful evaluation where available. First HN collection and then actual scoped predictions remain primary early checkpoints; no new UI prerequisite. A missing delegation token is an explicit blocker, never permission to forge labels.

Ryan now authorizes implementing this bounded first slice; no UI/email/Markus work is needed. Labels are actual human decisions, never invented; preserve holdout/order and report tiny-sample limits. PR367 is open and owns restricted user-session intake; reuse/coordinate it without duplicating handler/schema changes. A real HN RSS batch was fetched at 2026-10-20T03:13:48Z and three candidates presented for publication-specific human review; no labels or training applied.
